title:
Mary Rochfort, daughter of lord Molesworth, first countess of Belvedere.
 
 A listless lady, no more young, walked alone the shore of lough Ennel, Mary, first countess of Belvedere, listlessly walking in the evening, not startled when an otter plunged. Who could know the truth?
html_source: Father Conmee is dwelling on the story of the wife of Robert, 1st Earl of Belvedere (1707-1774). She was convicted of adultery with his brother, and kept a virtual prisoner by her husband for many years, until his death.
